# NOTE: this file is served at /pools/robots.txt, which crawlers ignore —
# robots.txt is only honoured at the domain root. It is kept for reference,
# and in case the site ever moves to its own domain root.
#
# The effective robots.txt is a STATIC file at the WordPress web root on WP
# Engine (thinkdesignprd) — not generated by WordPress, and not deployable
# from this repo. Edit it via Yoast SEO → Tools → File editor → robots.txt,
# or over SFTP/SSH. Do NOT try to push it with the deploy workflow: that
# action rsyncs with --delete, and aiming it at the web root would wipe the
# WordPress install.
#
# It carries a second Sitemap line for this site's sitemap, added 2026-09-01,
# because the Yoast sitemap_index.xml does not include /pools/. Keep it if
# that file is ever rewritten:
#   Sitemap: https://thinkdesign.com/pools/sitemap.xml
